P0001.rationale: The proposed exception cites the second sentence of 8 FAM 403.1-4(d)(1) ('If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;'). This sentence confers permission to issue a limited-validity passport under emergency circumstances (which is already accurately captured as a distinct permission claim in C0005). It does not formulate an explicit exception relieving personnel from the baseline duty to suspend the application, and the proposed action_quote ('suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name') does not appear within the span quoted for the proposal (1921–2103).
